component.name: Open Robot Arena
component.summary: Native Robot Arena 2 client and engine

description.p: Open Robot Arena is a native Linux client and engine for Robot Arena 2: Design & Destroy (Gabriel Interactive / Infogrames, 2003). It reads the original game's data files directly and does not run the original Windows executable.

The game is not included. The player supplies a Robot Arena 2 installation containing RA2.cfz, UI/ and Scripts/; the Flatpak asks for that directory on first run and passes it to the client as --game.

The client renders the original menu and workshop screens, runs the game's Python scripts on CPython 3.12, and ships headless rendering and physics tools (ra2-shell, ra2-render, ra2-sim, ra2-duel, ra2).
